seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Sterling, Virginia for 2026: Loudoun County's free Starry Nights and Winter Lights at Claude Moore Park.
lede: Sterling's Christmas season centers on Loudoun County's parks, where Claude Moore Park hosts a free nightly light display from December 5 to January 3.
celebrates: Sterling's holiday season runs on Loudoun County parks. Claude Moore Park, at 46150 Loudoun Park Lane, hosts Starry Nights and Winter Lights every night from December 5 to January 3, from 5 to 8 pm, and it is closed December 24 and 25. Admission is free and the county encourages registration through PRCS Connect. Special evenings include Holiday in the Park on Saturday, December 12, a walk through the park's Historic Area with crafts, hot chocolate and toasted marshmallows, and Cocoa and Mallows on Sunday, December 13. Parking is free at the Loudoun Heritage Farm Museum, and the path is gravel and grass.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Sterling's holiday events, so this page sticks to the 2026 schedule from Loudoun County and its hosts.
facts: LoudounGo's seasonal guide describes Starry Nights and Winter Lights as new this year for the county, with Claude Moore, Franklin and Hanson parks lighting up every night from December 5 to January 3. Each park has its own holiday theme, and Banshee Reeks Nature Preserve near Leesburg joins in on December 20 and 21 only. All the events are outdoors, so plan to dress for the weather.
trains: We did not confirm a Christmas train in Sterling itself. Virginia Railway Express runs Santa Trains on Saturday, December 12, 2026, boarding at stations including Manassas, Woodbridge, Burke Centre and Fredericksburg. Tickets are $10 per rider, sold online only starting November 30. Families in Sterling can look to Manassas for the closest of those boarding stations.

faq: Are there free Christmas events for kids in Sterling?

Yes. Loudoun County's Starry Nights and Winter Lights at Claude Moore Park is free. It runs every night from December 5, 2026 to January 3, 2027, from 5 to 8 pm, and the county encourages registration through PRCS Connect.
Where do I park for the Claude Moore Park lights?
Enter from Loudoun Park Lane and park at the Loudoun Heritage Farm Museum, 21668 Heritage Farm Lane. Parking is free, and the path is gravel and grass, so wear sturdy shoes.
Is Starry Nights and Winter Lights open on Christmas Eve?
No. The county holds no events at any location on December 24 or 25. The display is open every other night from December 5 through January 3.
Which other Loudoun parks have holiday lights?
Franklin Park in Purcellville and Hal and Berni Hanson Regional Park in Aldie join Claude Moore Park every night. Banshee Reeks Nature Preserve near Leesburg is lit on December 20 and 21 only.
